standard: A user-facing fix is preserved only when the intended user can see it, understand it, and naturally reach the correct journey.
regressions_found_and_fixed: A public-profile PENDING access state still linked directly to Profile Center instead of the free Profile Access authority-review journey.
The signed-in Profile Access journey still sent an unverified linked profile to Profile Center to submit or check authority evidence.
The correction-success follow-up still offered Profile Center without proving management authority.
r1345_repairs: Profile Access now accepts management-authority evidence directly.
Pending Profile Access exposes status refresh and request withdrawal.
Unverified membership entry routes back to exact-profile Profile Access.
Public-profile pending state routes to exact-profile Profile Access.
Correction success routes ordinary claim/manage follow-up through exact-profile Profile Access.
Verified managers still receive Profile Center; disputed access still routes to support.
The permanent non-burial gate extends through R1345 and an authority-routing gate prevents future bypass.
